item.title: How ONESTRUCTION built the Ishigaki-IDS foundation model with AWS GenAIIC
item.summary: ONESTRUCTION, with technical advisory from the AWS Generative AI Innovation Center, built Ishigaki-IDS, a foundation model specialized for construction and BIM workflows. This architectural case study shows how they combined synthetic data, a three-stage training pipeline, and verifiable rewards on Amazon EC2 to build a domain model in a data-scarce field.
